image:image.image:caption: From the south-bank walk the two Portland-stone towers of Tower Bridge stand over a closed bascule roadway, joined by the high-level walkways, with the blue chains falling toward each bank. The Thames is grey-green under a solid cloud deck. It is a dry overcast morning, about 21.3°C, and the sun is not in the sky.
image:image.image:title: Tower Bridge, London

image:image.image:caption: From the east sidewalk of Westminster Bridge the view looks northwest to Elizabeth Tower, the clock tower at the north end of the Palace of Westminster. A dark clock face and the green copper roof sit against a flat grey sky, and the Gothic riverside range continues beside the tower. The morning is overcast and dry, about 21.4°C, with no sun in the frame.
image:image.image:title: Elizabeth Tower, London

image:image.image:caption: From the Victoria Memorial the view looks west along the Mall axis to the east front of Buckingham Palace, the 1913 Portland-stone facade with its central balcony and pediment. The memorial and the forecourt gates sit in the near ground and do not hide the balcony. The sky is a solid grey deck, about 21.3°C, dry, and the sun is not visible.
